verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS platform like Hightouch, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents any way for users to opt out of Hightouch's own telemetry or usage tracking. The Events SDKs and data-contract features govern customer data the user collects, which is an adjacent capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
